breaking_news.headline: The business of El Niño
breaking_news.summary: El Niño is expected to bring wild weather, but it's also business opportunity for some. Contractors are booked up as homeowners prepare for heavy rains and ski resorts gear up to cash in on snow.

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia shares tumble as the company says it's investigating CEO Jensen Huang
breaking_news.summary: Nvidia's share price falls after the company begins an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's alleged relationship with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy.

breaking_news.headline: Why did California's billionaire tax fail to surf the blue wave?
breaking_news.summary: Two economists debate what California's vote on Prop 40 means for the wealth tax movement.

breaking_news.headline: The average cost for a new vehicle in the U.S. hits a record high: over $51,000
breaking_news.summary: Vehicle transaction prices are up to a new record high, according to the Kelley Blue Book — and some buyers are extending their car loans to finance them.

breaking_news.headline: Gas prices dip below $4 but inflation remains stubbornly high
breaking_news.summary: Gasoline prices fell below $4 a gallon Tuesday for the first time in three months — but the overall cost of living remains stubbornly high.

breaking_news.headline: Americans across the economic spectrum feel a 'panic' about finances, author says
breaking_news.summary: Mona Chalabi spent five years following Americans living paycheck to paycheck, as well as those earning top wages. Her new book, Ten Lives, explores why financial security can feel so elusive.

breaking_news.headline: Should you trust new AI agents with your money and data?
breaking_news.summary: Tech companies want agentic AI to be the new way you shop. But should you trust AI when your money's involved?

breaking_news.headline: The scandal surrounding the head of Nvidia could have wide-ranging implications
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer speaks with Bloomberg tech reporter Ian King about the unusually overarching role of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at his company and within the American tech industry at large.

breaking_news.headline: First day of Ukraine peace talks constructive, Zelensky says
breaking_news.summary: Delegations from Kyiv, Washington and Moscow are in the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February.

breaking_news.headline: Board of Peace says Israel's aid response after Gaza floods 'insufficent'
breaking_news.summary: The group, formed by Trump, issues rare criticism of Israel, while also blaming Hamas for the suffering of civilians in Gaza.

breaking_news.headline: Anti-homosexuality laws in Trinidad and Tobago overturned
breaking_news.summary: The ruling brings to an end an 11-year legal battle by dual-citizen Jason Jones.

breaking_news.headline: Spain's king and queen attend memorial service for rail crash victims
breaking_news.summary: Sixty-nine people died in the collision near Toledo two weeks ago and 28 are still in hospital.

breaking_news.headline: Violence erupts in Bangladesh as ousted PM's supporters stage protest
breaking_news.summary: Supporters of Sheikh Hasina want her to return from exile in India.

breaking_news.headline: Israel's new parliament sworn in as leaders compete to form government
breaking_news.summary: Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, has first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.

breaking_news.headline: Malaysia's disgraced former PM leaves jail for house arrest after embezzling millions

breaking_news.headline: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
breaking_news.summary: The 82-year-old was placed under house detention in Florida last week after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.

breaking_news.headline: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
